subject: Future Tech
title: Germline vs Somatic Editing
description: A short lesson to help you apply Germline vs Somatic Editing.

hook.text: Somatic editing changes cells in a living person.

buildup.text: Somatic edits die with the patient. They cure one person. Germline edits alter the human gene pool permanently.

discovery.text: Most scientists support somatic editing for diseases. Germline editing is where the ethical line gets drawn sharply.

twist.text: A germline fix for a deadly disease could spare millions of future children.

climax.text: No country has approved germline editing in humans. The global consensus is caution, but pressure to allow it grows.

punchline.text: Fixing one embryo changes every generation after it.

quiz.question: What is the key difference between germline and somatic editing?
options: Germline changes pass to future generations
